summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by argenx SE, a foreign private issuer, announcing an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for September 17, 2026. The agenda includes the proposed appointments of two non-executive directors to the Board. This is a routine corporate governance matter and not a special situation. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or other exceptional corporate event. The meeting notice and director appointments are ordinary business items, with no indication of forced management changes or other special circumstances. Per classification guidelines, this is a routine current report and should be categorized as None.
